title: Make brand events idempotent
body: Beacon uses the originating brand's event identifier to make inbound event processing idempotent. Repeated delivery of the same event must not create duplicate downstream effects.

attributes.statement: Beacon must use the brand-generated event_id as the idempotency key for inbound events.
attributes.rationale: Webhook delivery can be retried or duplicated, so Beacon cannot safely assume exactly-once delivery. A stable event identifier allows repeated delivery to be recognized without duplicating processing or downstream effects.

alternatives_rejected.reason: External event delivery cannot provide a safe exactly-once guarantee.
